items.text: I'm on my second course of Prednisone since Aug 3 when I woke up totally deaf in my right ear. I am taking a higher amount (60mg for another 3 days and then gradually tapering down to 1 last pill on Aug 28th). The first ENT I saw didn't prescribe a high enough dose or long enough schedule. I've now gained 15lbs (of water weight mostly). There's been some sugar cravings and my calories have increased even with me being on a glp-1. It's been seriously tough on me to feel my gut balloon out. I just keep researching the best ways to eat and manage my mood/sleep cycle hoping I return to my baseline within a couple of months. My heart is with you. Keep looking into others experiences and how they cope and it will provide some needed insight. You can just do a general search for Prednisone weight gain, etc.
